contexts.text: A graven thing = the falsity, a molten thing the evil, which is of proprium. AC 424.
Their faces appeared... as graven things without life.
A graven thing () = false persuasions from principles conceived and hatched by self.
A wooden graven thing = cupidities.
(An innocent Spirit who had adored a graven thing.) HH 324. SE 2411.
Instead of groves, graven things of a grove. Illustrated.
By a graven thing is signified the falsity of evil.
By these carvings () was represented the state of Heaven.

Thou shaft not make to thyself a graven thing () = not from Own intelligence. A graven thing = what is not from the Lord, but from the proprium of man: that which is from the intellectual proprium is signified by a graven thing, and that which is from the voluntary proprium by a molten thing.
These are the formers of graven things; and the graven things themselves are what they hatch from proprium, and want to have worshipped as Divine things.
That these things are signified by graven things. Illustrated. AC 8932:5. AC 8941:end.
The writing and the graving on the tables = those things which have been impressed on the memory and on the life; and which are therefore to remain. AC 9841.

A graven thing of silver, etc. = doctrine from Own intelligence, and not from the Lord; thus from the external sense of the Word separated from the internal sense; which is made with those who are merely in external things... that is, with those who are in the loves of self and of the world... AC 9424:7. AC 9424:8. AC 9424:9.
The reason the onyx stones, from the graving in them, = the interior memory. Explained. AC 9841:3.

Thou shalt grave upon them the names of the sons of Israel () = on which are impressed the goods and truths of the Spiritual Kingdom as to all their quality. To engrave on stones = to impress on the memory.

With the engravings of a signet shalt thou engrave the two stones, according to the names of the sons of Israel () = the heavenly form of all the Truths in their order, in the memory... The engravings of a signet = the heavenly form of all Truths, such as it is in the Intellectual of one who is regenerate; for therein the truths of faith are disposed into a heavenly form... To engrave stones = to impress on the memory.
A graven thing () = the doctrine of falsity which is from Own intelligence, and thus is devoid of life from the Divine.
The engravings of a signet = the heavenly form.

Thou shalt engrave upon it with the engraving of a signet () = what is perpetual and impressed on the hearts according to the heavenly sphere. To engrave = to impress on the memory, thus also on the heart; for that which is impressed on the interior memory, which is of the life, is said to be impressed on the heart; and as this remains to eternity, there is also signified perpetually. The engraving of a signet = the heavenly sphere... The things which are impressed on the memory, especially on the interior memory... are impressed according to the heavenly sphere. Explained.
In the engraving of a stone for filling () = to represent all things of faith which serve the good of love. The engraving of a stone = a representative of all things of faith from love. Explained.
In the engraving of wood ito make in all work () = to represent every good whatever. Explained.

In the Word passim there are mentioned graven things and molten things... Idols are not meant, but false doctrinal things of the Church; such things as are formed by man himself, when he is led by some love of his own. The formation of these falsities, so that they may cohere, and appear as if they were truths, is signified by a graven thing; and their conjunction to the favour of external loves, so that evils may appear as goods, is signified by a molten thing. AC 10406:3, Illustrated.
The Angels in temples, whether carved or painted...
There are some to whom the graven things serve as a means to excite thought about God...
He would not be a man, but... a graven thing.
They appear before the Angels like graven things of wood... AR 224:12.
We saw wood and stone carved into figures of men, etc... Every graven thing represents some part of a virtue or of a Truth...
They then seemed to me like graven things of rock...
Graven things and idols = falsities which are from Own intelligence. ( = falsities of doctrine. AE 237.) AE 304:34. AE 355:17. AE 386:4.
The engraving of a signet = permanence to eternity.
Idols, graven things, and molten things = the falsities of doctrine, of religion, and of worship. Illustrated.
Their graven things = things falsified which are from Own intelligence.
To engrave an engraving = a representative and significative of it.

The men of those Churches made for themselves graven things and images of various things, which represented heavenly things; and the Ancients were delighted with them from the fact that they signified such things; and therefore when they looked at them, they remembered the heavenly things which they represented; and as these things belonged to their religion, they worshipped them. Hence they had carved, cast, and painted figures...
Hence the Jews were so strictly forbidden to make for themselves graven things...
It is from general influx... that the graven things (of the Catholics) are loved.
A graven thing () = the evil of worship.
